About.title: About
About.p1: I build React interfaces focused on real business impact — not just shipping components. As the sole frontend engineer on a B2B health platform, I've owned frontend decisions and delivery end-to-end: a full checkout rebuild that eliminated daily support interventions across the client base, and a financial statement module designed for lean bundle size and clear user value.
About.p2: Beyond my main role, I've independently delivered 10+ web projects and built TimeCode Sites — a Website-as-a-Service product with AI content generation, Stripe subscriptions, and custom domain provisioning — from idea to production, solo.
About.open: Open to global relocation and remote opportunities.

bullets: Rebuilt the entire logged-in checkout in React with dynamic dependent addition, real-time cost recalculation via Context API, and a custom multi-step flow — eliminating daily support interventions across 1,000+ client companies.

Built the financial statement module from scratch with component reuse to keep the bundle lean, giving account holders direct visibility into financial history previously handled only through brokers.
Improved order queue error visibility on TOTVS ERP API failures and developed custom Gutenberg blocks for dynamic content per company and user segment.
Shipped pixel-perfect landing pages for Pedalgel from Figma in Next.js and SCSS Modules, with an integrated external checkout. The product sold 60,000+ units and reached 10+ countries.
Delivered additional web projects across niches under tight timelines, including a digital entrepreneurship platform and a couples mentorship site.
